# DuckDB would compare IS DISTINCT FROM operands by the internal names of anonymous or duplicate
# fields, taking NULL fields as values. Other forms below also remain deliberately unsupported.

SELECT STRUCT(1, 2) IS DISTINCT FROM STRUCT(1, 2)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

SELECT CAST(STRUCT(1, 2) AS JSON)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

SELECT (SELECT AS STRUCT k, SUM(a) FROM (SELECT 1 AS k) GROUP BY k) FROM UNNEST([1, 2]) AS a
=> error contains: The emulator does not support
